- Initial release of honeybook-fpx for reading HoneyBook client-portal data using fpx CLI and curl, without requiring the honeybook-mcp server.
- Supports one-time session capture from a signed-in browser tab via the Transporter extension; subsequent data access uses plain curl.
- Handles contracts, invoices, proposals, payment methods, and workspace status by extracting session and user tokens from localStorage and crafting authenticated API requests.
- Documents error handling, rate limiting, API version management, and required call headers for successful automation.
- Provides detailed setup instructions and ready-to-use shell command patterns for HoneyBook API access outside the official server environment.
